results.title: Lab testing — HPLC, endotoxin, mass spec · AverianLabs
results.mainText:
Understanding laboratory reports

Read the original report for the selected batch. The methods below describe different analytical questions and do not imply that every product has undergone every test.

Chromatographic purity

HPLC reports describe a result under a specified analytical method. Chromatographic purity should not be treated as a measurement of the total amount of material in a container.

Identity and composition

Mass spectrometry can provide molecular-mass evidence. A sequence or composition claim needs the appropriate supporting analysis and specification; mass alone is not a complete sequence determination.

Product-specific tests

Endotoxin, sterility and other test results are shown only when applicable and supported by the report. Retain the units used in the original result, such as EU/mg.

View batch documents
Request a quote

results.title: Quality assurance · AverianLabs
results.mainText:
Quality and product documentation

Evaluate materials using the documents for the actual product and batch. Availability of a report is shown explicitly; missing reports are not presented as verified results.

Product identity

Check the chemical identity, composition, quantity and unit against the original specification. Analytical purity, material content and identity are different measurements.

Batch evidence

A report should identify the batch, laboratory, test method, result, unit and date. Accreditation or supplier quality claims are published only when their supporting evidence has been approved.

Storage and handling

Use the conditions in the product-specific documentation. Do not assume that the same storage or preparation conditions apply to every material.

results.title: Lab testing — HPLC, endotoxin, mass spec · AverianLabs
results.mainText:
Understanding laboratory reports

Read the original report for the selected batch. The methods below describe different analytical questions and do not imply that every product has undergone every test.

Chromatographic purity

HPLC reports describe a result under a specified analytical method. Chromatographic purity should not be treated as a measurement of the total amount of material in a container.

Identity and composition

Mass spectrometry can provide molecular-mass evidence. A sequence or composition claim needs the appropriate supporting analysis and specification; mass alone is not a complete sequence determination.

Product-specific tests

Endotoxin, sterility and other test results are shown only when applicable and supported by the report. Retain the units used in the original result, such as EU/mg.

View batch documents
Request a quote

results.title: Quality assurance · AverianLabs
results.mainText:
Quality and product documentation

Evaluate materials using the documents for the actual product and batch. Availability of a report is shown explicitly; missing reports are not presented as verified results.

Product identity

Check the chemical identity, composition, quantity and unit against the original specification. Analytical purity, material content and identity are different measurements.

Batch evidence

A report should identify the batch, laboratory, test method, result, unit and date. Accreditation or supplier quality claims are published only when their supporting evidence has been approved.

Storage and handling

Use the conditions in the product-specific documentation. Do not assume that the same storage or preparation conditions apply to every material.
